subject: Sampler exact-factory enable hook for v2
body: Added tegu_sampler_enable_exact_factory(1) in sampler_state.inc. The ordinary newSamplerStateWithDescriptor: stays legacy-narrow by default; when the v2 sidecar transport is actually live, render/compute submit owner should call this once so ordinary Metal sampler creation retains exact state. Render's existing tegu_sampler_legacy_word_ok guard already prevents silent old-word reduction. This keeps existing sampler_state_host_test.inc legacy assertions passing until the hook is enabled. Also reminder: bridge still needs l.swizzle_valid and view-format sampler info fixes. No phone/build/commit.
